result.title: STROKE: Simple Sparse Structural Occlusions for Black-Box Adversarial Attacks
result.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables, and 16 pages of Supplementary Information with 3 figures and 5 tables
result.summary: We introduce STROKE, a query-efficient score-based black-box adversarial attack that constructs perturbations from simple oriented rectangular occlusions. STROKE optimizes these perturbations through a lightweight greedy add-and-refine procedure. Across diverse image classifiers, STROKE achieves high attack success with low query counts at nominal 1--2\% area settings, showing favorable performance relative to existing patch-based attacks in several configurations. Matched comparisons further demonstrate substantial reductions in wall-clock attack time, while ablation studies examine the key design choices and effectiveness across structural primitives. These findings suggest that simple structural occlusions offer an effective and computationally efficient search space for black-box adversarial attacks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 STROKE：一种基于分数查询的黑盒对抗攻击，用少量有向矩形遮挡拼成扰动，并以轻量贪心「添加—精修」流程在低查询数、1–2% 面积预算下优化攻击效果。
